notes: Adapted from the fork's shared mage default (ui/mage/apls/p1.apl.json), which is the Fire branch of a package that falls back to Frostbolt for non-Fire specs. Two bugs in that preset are fixed here: it named the Improved Scorch talent id (12873) as the debuff to track, which does not exist in spellconst -- the talent (11095) actually triggers a separate debuff, Fire Vulnerability (22959), and that is the id this rotation tracks stacks and remaining time against. Its Fireball and Frostbolt references were also stale ranks (10) where the build's current top ranks are 12 (25306) and 11 (25304) respectively; Frostbolt is dropped entirely since this file is Fire-specific and never falls back to it. Fire Blast is added on cooldown as a free extra nuke per community guides, which the shared preset omitted. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Pop Combustion once Fire Vulnerability (from Improved Scorch) is fully stacked, for a guaranteed run of Fire crits.
Scorch to apply or refresh the five stacks of Fire Vulnerability before it falls off.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete for Scorch or Fireball casts.
Fireball is the primary filler once Fire Vulnerability is up.
